description:
Strict configuration contract for an LLM provider endpoint.

Validated at initialization time to catch misconfigurations early.

base_url.description: API base URL. Required for ollama and openai_compatible providers.
base_url.title: Base Url

api_key_env.description: Environment variable name holding the API key (e.g., 'OPENAI_API_KEY')
api_key_env.title: Api Key Env

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Low values (0.0-0.2) for deterministic translation.
temperature.title: Temperature

system_prompt_template.description: Custom system prompt template. Use {src_lang_name} and {tgt_lang_name} as placeholders. If None, uses built-in default.
system_prompt_template.title: System Prompt Template

title: LLMProviderConfig
